annotation_note: Development-only synthetic boundary personas for IGNWPS-MH, PM-KISAN-IN, and IGNOAPS-MH. Expected outcomes were written before harness scoring. IGNOAPS personas use typed_facts (name_on_bpl_list). First labeller role5-seed. A second, model-assisted label exists for 60 personas (eval/development/role1_model_assisted_labels_2.json); it is NOT an independent human label. Human second labelling is still pending. Not held-out; not the final 60-set. | Personas R1-* (29) added by Role 1: 3 on live schemes and 26 boundary personas on gold development schemes. R1-GOLD-* verdicts are computed from the draft gold rules in data/schemes/rule_gold_drafts/; exclusion-kind rules apply when their fact is true, and each eligible verdict has its exclusion facts set to false. The 60 R1-* and Balaji personas have model-assisted checks only; no independent human labels yet. Not held-out. | R1-GOLD-027 to R1-GOLD-043 (17 personas) added 2026-11-11 for 6 new development gold schemes: FAISHL-IN, IPMWCD-IN, EACS-MH, NSMNY-MH, IGNWPSM-MH, BFFL-MH. All typed_facts; expected verdicts drafted by a model from the gold rules and not yet human-labelled. Dates: YYYY-MM-DD throughout.
